titulo.es: Indonesia: potente erupción del Anak Krakatoa provoca cancelación de vuelos y capa intensa de ceniza
titulo.en: Volcanic eruption halts flights at Jakarta and seven other Indonesian airports

sintesis.es: Una potente erupción del volcán Anak Krakatoa en Indonesia obligó a la cancelación de cientos de vuelos. La columna de ceniza alcanzó hasta 15 km de altura y afectó a miles de personas, quienes reportaron intensas capas de ceniza. Mientras tanto, las autoridades mantienen la alerta.
sintesis.en: Ash cloud from Anak Krakatau affects hundreds of flights and some school and fishing activities Indonesia halted operations at eight airports on Sunday, including from its main international hub, affecting hundreds of flights as a result of an ash cloud from the Anak Krakatau volcano. Saturday’s eruption, which produced lava and booming sounds that were heard up to 435 miles (700km) away, according to Indonesia’s geology agency, also interrupted some school activities and fishing. Two more eruptions were recorded on Sunday.

titulo.es: Alemania: empieza la votación en Sajonia-Anhalt, una elección decisiva para la AfD
titulo.en: Ulrich Siegmund: From CDU member to AfD lead candidate

sintesis.es: Abrieron este domingo las urnas en Sajonia-Anhalt, región de la antigua Alemania Oriental donde el partido de extrema derecha Alternativa por Alemania (AfD) podría lograr una victoria histórica. Sería la primera vez que un partido radical obtuviera tal resultado desde la Segunda Guerra Mundial. La AfD cuenta con más del 40 % en las encuestas, es decir, casi 20 puntos por delante de la CDU, el partido conservador del canciller Friedrich Merz, que actualmente gobierna la región.
sintesis.en: Ulrich Siegmund is the AfD's leading figure in Saxony-Anhalt: 35, media-savvy and aiming to be minister-president. At the next state election he wants to lead his party into government.

titulo.es: Infantino mantiene su candidatura a la reelección en la FIFA a pesar de las críticas
titulo.en: Under-fire FIFA boss Infantino to seek re-election despite calls to resign

sintesis.es: Pese a la crisis y la oposición de algunas confederaciones por su estilo de gobernar, el actual presidente de la FIFA, Gianni Infantino, confirmó este domingo que será candidato a la reelección el próximo año, según un portavoz de la instancia. El dirigente es el único candidato declarado por el momento para la votación que tendrá lugar en marzo de 2027.
sintesis.en: FIFA President Gianni Infantino plans to seek his fourth and final term in next year’s election, despite the outrage sparked by his now-shelved plan to sell stakes in the World Cup to private investors. “Nothing has changed,” a spokesman for football’s governing body confirmed on Sunday, referring to an announcement Infantino made back in April.

titulo.es: At least five dead after Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport
titulo.en: At least five dead after Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport

sintesis.es: Three people in critical condition and two hospitalized as operations at one of busiest US airports brought to a halt An Amazon cargo plane crashed at Miami international airport in Florida on Sunday afternoon after the flight, which was arriving from Puerto Rico, overshot the runway, striking several vehicles and resulting in at least five deaths. The plane erupted in flames as dark smoke billowed into the sky, bringing operations at one of the busiest airports in the US to a halt. The pilot and copilot were trapped in the cockpit as a result of the crash, said the Miami-Dade rescue fire chief Ray Jadallah.

titulo.es: Suspensión masiva de vuelos en el principal aeropuerto de Indonesia por la erupción de un volcán
titulo.en: Indonesia’s most dangerous fires are burning underground

sintesis.es: El monte Anak Krakatoa es un volcán activo situado en el estrecho de Sonda, entre las islas de Java y Sumatra.
sintesis.en: Indonesia’s dangerous peat fires are surging early in the 2026 fire season as a strengthening El Niño and severe drought dry out wetlands that can burn underground for months. These slow smoldering fires are especially destructive because they release far more fine particles and several pollutants than typical tropical forest fires, while thick smoke can make them difficult for satellites to detect.
